summary: Focused iteration-2 retest passed: auth roles/me/logout/protected access, mobile landing width, admin availability targeting, concurrent booking lock, report privacy/file authorization, doctor search, legal navigation, and invalid OAuth callback.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking issues found in the focused retest. Production build compiled successfully.
seed_data_creation: No seeded users created; uploaded one TEST private PDF report and created test availability/appointment records against existing demo accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focused regression is green. The browser runner reported only a test-script Page.evaluate quoting error after all assertions had passed; no application failure. Reminder scheduler and full doctor/admin UI flows were not exercised in this iteration.
rca of the issue: Iteration-1 issues were resolved in the implementation: html/body overflow is hidden on mobile, AvailabilityCreate accepts doctor_id and validates the selected doctor, startup creates a unique slot_locks index for atomic conflict handling, and appointment responses use public() to remove MongoDB _id.
